reference.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: single transparent hero character reference for a tiny mobile RPG sprite
Input image is the approved fourth hero concept. Preserve its exact identity, head-to-body ratio, RIGHT-facing profile, brown chunky hair silhouette, red scarf/cape, blue tunic, grey simple shoulder plate on near arm, brown boots and wide short sword held in the LEFT HAND (the far hand on screen RIGHT). The near/right hand on screen LEFT remains EMPTY and visible at the waist. Arms very short and natural. Feet are short and wide. No neck.
Change only the rendering to completely flat solid color regions like a tiny printed game sticker. No gradients, no shading, no highlights, no light direction, no metal shine, no texture. Remove all internal hair highlight shapes and armor shine. Hair ONE brown shape. Blade ONE pale grey shape. Keep broad dark organic outlines and a single tiny dark oval eye. Preserve existing compact two-head proportions; don't make baby head overly huge.
Color palette exactly: #231B15 outline; #815337 hair, gloves, boots and belt; #F2C691 skin; #3769AA blue tunic; #C94943 scarf and cape; #BEC9CC armor and blade; #D5AA59 sword guard. Seven flat spot colors.
Composition: single full body facing RIGHT, feet same baseline, short sword diagonally up to right at relaxed waist height with tip no higher than face, hand unmistakably holding handle; empty near hand visible. Generous transparent margins.
No additional objects, no backdrop or shadow, no text, no logos, no watermark. Real transparent background.

clips.action: breathing loop: 1 approved relaxed reference pose, sword diagonally up toward screen RIGHT held by far/LEFT hand at right waist, EMPTY near/right fist at LEFT hip; 2 body breathes slightly lower and wider, same short arm anatomy.
clips.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: transparent 2D game animation strip, exact same HERO identity as reference image.
Reference is final flat color reference. Preserve brown chunky hair, single oval eye, red scarf and short cape, blue tunic, grey shoulder and wrist plates on NEAR/RIGHT arm on screen LEFT, brown mittens/boots, LEFT-HANDED short silver blade at screen RIGHT. Near/right empty fist, far/left sword fist. Compact TWO-head tall stocky proportions, NO neck, very short limbs.
Style: bold organic dark contour, perfectly flat color fields, seven solid colors only: #231B15 outline, #815337 brown, #F2C691 skin, #3769AA blue, #C94943 red, #BEC9CC grey, #D5AA59 gold. Absolutely no shading, shadows, gradients, highlights, texture, metal shine, extra details or decoration.
Face RIGHT in every frame. Preserve sword hand, face and equipment consistently.
Primary request: idle animation in EXACTLY 2 separated frames in ONE HORIZONTAL ROW. breathing loop: 1 approved relaxed reference pose, sword diagonally up toward screen RIGHT held by far/LEFT hand at right waist, EMPTY near/right fist at LEFT hip; 2 body breathes slightly lower and wider, same short arm anatomy.
Composition: wide landscape 2:1 canvas, equal-width cells, consistent scale across every frame (no zoom or shrinking). Generous transparent margins and gaps between full characters, every body/weapon entirely visible. Same floor baseline except small intentional walk rise. True transparent background, no shadow, no grid, no label, no text, no watermark.

clips.action: walk RIGHT IN PLACE: 1 near boot steps forward screen right, far boot behind screen left; 2 legs pass underneath with body a little raised; 3 far boot steps forward right, near boot behind left; 4 opposite passing pose. Exactly two short legs, modest alternate steps, slightly swinging empty near/right arm, cape moves subtly. Far/LEFT hand keeps sword out on screen RIGHT, no weapon switching, no long arms. Both hands remain visible when not occluded naturally.

clips.action: Casting with EMPTY NEAR/RIGHT hand; far/LEFT hand holds sword angled down beside RIGHT waist in first3 frames. Do NOT move casting hand to screen right; leave it beside the NEAR/RIGHT shoulder on the LEFT of picture. Far/LEFT sword glove stays at right hip, visible holding lowered sword. Frame4 reference neutral stance, empty near/right fist lowers to LEFT waist and far/left sword points diagonally RIGHT. Exactly TWO arms, ONE grey short forearm per arm. No large effect.

postprocess_approval: 사용자가 왼손 검 기준 그림을 단색으로 적용하도록 선택. 앞선 Pillow 평탄화 승인에 따라 원본과 알파를 보존하며 단색 처리.

postprocess.normalization: 클립마다 기준 포즈로 생성 줌을 통일. 한 클립 안에서는 공통 배율 사용. 슬라임 걷기는 면적 중간값으로 줌을 맞춰 눌림·늘어남 보존.
